cases.question: How do I reset my password?
cases.baseline_answer: Click “Forgot password” on the login page and enter your email. A reset link will be sent to you and is valid for 30 minutes. Let me know if you need any more help!
cases.candidate_answer: Click “Forgot password” on the login page and enter your email. The reset link you receive will be valid for 30 minutes.

cases.question: What plans and pricing do you offer?
cases.baseline_answer:
We offer three plans:  
- Free: 5 GB of storage.  
- Pro: $9 / month for 100 GB.  
- Team: $20 / user / month for 1 TB shared storage.

cases.question: Is there a free trial?
cases.baseline_answer: Yes! Pro users can try it out with a 14‑day free trial—no credit card is required.

cases.question: How do I cancel my subscription?
cases.baseline_answer: Go to Settings > Billing > Cancel plan. You’ll keep access until the end of the current billing period.

cases.question: What is your refund policy?
cases.baseline_answer: We give a full refund if you ask within 14 days of your first purchase. After 14 days, payments are not refunded. Let us know if you need help with a refund request!
cases.candidate_answer: We give a full refund if you request it within 14 days of your first purchase. After 14 days, payments are not refunded.

cases.question: What is the maximum file size I can upload?
cases.baseline_answer: Free accounts can upload files up to 250 MB, while Pro and Team accounts allow uploads up to 2 GB.

cases.question: Can I recover a deleted file?
cases.baseline_answer: Yes! Deleted files stay in the Trash for 30 days, and you can restore them from there.
cases.candidate_answer: Yes, you can recover a deleted file. Deleted files stay in the Trash for 30 days and can be restored from there.

cases.question: Is my data encrypted?
cases.baseline_answer: Yes! All your files are encrypted with AES‑256 at rest and protected with TLS 1.3 while in transit.

cases.question: How do I contact support?
cases.baseline_answer: You can reach us by emailing support@cloudnest.example or using the live chat Monday‑Friday, 9 am‑6 pm IST. We aim to reply to emails within 24 hours. Let us know how we can help!

cases.question: How do I delete my account?
cases.baseline_answer: Go to Settings > Account > Delete account. The deletion will be permanent after a 14‑day grace period. Let us know if you need any more help!
